frames: MOVE 3: Market Garden: 3 airborne divisions drop along one road; the front line (two-coloured, wide map)
XXX Corps tanks up the single road to Arnhem: 64 miles, 5 big bridges
Gavin (37) commands the 82nd: the bridges around Nijmegen, the great Waal road bridge
17-19 Sept: attacks from the south on the bridge stopped by SS troops (Valkhof / Hunner Park)
The river guards the north end: ~300 m of open water; the front line runs along the Waal
Gavin's plan: cross downstream, land on the north bank, take the bridge from both ends
26 canvas boats arrive at the power station (3 paddles each)
20 Sept ~15:00: the crossing under MG, mortar and flak fire; boats hit
MG bursts; boom + SHAKE on every mortar/shell impact
Cook, paddling: Hail Mary, full of grace
About half make it: up the dike, then east toward the bridges
North ends of the railway and road bridges taken; the front line moves north
~19:00: British tanks cross the Waal bridge, dusk light
Casualty card: 48 killed in the crossing, 100+ wounded; German unknown
